description: This file defines a Perl package 'metadata' that provides functions and variables for parsing and managing package and target metadata, including package dependencies, user/group info, and target configurations.

methods.name: get_multiline
methods.description: Reads multiline string from file handle until '@@' marker, optionally prepending a prefix to each line.

methods.name: confstr
methods.description: Sanitizes configuration string by replacing certain characters with underscores.

methods.name: parse_package_metadata_usergroup
methods.description: Parses user or group specification strings, validates IDs and names, and updates corresponding hashes.

methods.name: parse_target_metadata
methods.description: Parses target configuration files to extract target properties, profiles, dependencies, and subtargets.

methods.name: clear_packages
methods.description: Clears all package and related metadata hashes.

methods.name: parse_package_metadata
methods.description: Parses package metadata files to extract package details, dependencies, and associated source info.

methods.name: parse_package_manifest_metadata
methods.description: Parses package manifest files to extract package details and dependencies.
